headline: Colombia Fiscal Council Warns Rescue Law Leaves $9.6 Trillion Deficit
summary: Colombia's Autonomous Fiscal Rule Committee (Carf) warned that the proposed Rescue Law will leave a 9.6 trillion peso fiscal gap and project public debt to reach 78.1% of GDP by 2030.
why: Colombia's fiscal rule compliance and public debt trajectory are closely monitored by credit rating agencies evaluating investment-grade status.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Carf cautioned that fiscal shortfall and VAT modifications will push public debt toward 78.1% of GDP by 2030.
